equal_compute.quantity: ResNet / CNN ratio of realized self-play collection seconds plus optimizer-update seconds, all generations
equal_compute.rule: inside approximately_equal: equal-compute claim allowed; inside qualified only: comparison described as roughly comparable computation; outside: no equal-compute claim of any kind

analysis.multiplicity: none declared; one primary endpoint, everything else is supporting

recommendation.keep_cnn: strength FAIL or tactical gate FAIL

next_investment_indicators.replay_optimization: generation-6 replay mirror-duplicate fraction above 0.40, or generation-6 post-ply-8 self-play duplicate fraction above 0.30, in the better arm
next_investment_indicators.tactical_search: generation-6 raw-PUCT immediate-win or safe-response accuracy below 0.95 in the better arm
next_investment_indicators.value_learning: generation-6 raw exact-value MSE on solved300 at or above 0.9 x the constant-zero MSE in both architectures, or prequential held-out value MSE above the constant-zero MSE

recommendation.note: the indicators inform a judgment; they are not an automatic selection
recommendation.otherwise: no demonstrated advantage: the CNN stays the default because it is cheaper per position; the ResNet is not rejected
recommendation.replace: strength PASS, equal-compute claim not invalid, tactical gate not FAIL

analysis.resampling: paired cluster bootstrap within seed: opening families for matches (both colors stay together), Phase 4D.4G mirror/prefix clusters for position suites; pooled = equal-weight mean of the two seeds, resampled independently

secondary_pairings.equal_compute: same generation index (2, 4, 6): the arms have had about the same computation
secondary_pairings.equal_games: CNN generation 4 against ResNet generation 6 (576 games and 576 updates each); raw-network measures also CNN generation 2 against ResNet generation 3 (288 each). Descriptive: these checkpoints differ in generation count, replay refreshes and wall time and are not a matched experiment

strength.FAIL: both seeds < 0 and pooled 95% upper bound < 0
strength.INCONCLUSIVE: anything else, and always when the endpoint is saturated
strength.PASS: both seeds > 0, pooled difference >= +0.05, pooled 95% lower bound > 0, and pooled difference at generation 4 >= 0
strength.endpoint: ResNet minus CNN match score against the fixed opponent at generation 6 of each arm
strength.saturated: mean generation-6 score of the four arms outside [0.10, 0.90]

analysis.supporting_rule: BETTER/WORSE for any other contrast: both seeds agree in sign and the pooled 95% interval excludes zero; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE (signs oriented so that lower loss/error and higher accuracy/score favor the ResNet)

tactical.FAIL: any category: pooled difference <= -0.05 and pooled 95% upper bound < 0
tactical.PASS: both categories: pooled difference >= -0.03 and pooled 95% lower bound >= -0.10
tactical.endpoint: ResNet minus CNN raw-PUCT accuracy on tactical200 at generation 6, immediate-win and safe-response categories separately; the same rule on the raw policy is reported and is not binding

value.BETTER: both seeds < 0 and pooled 95% upper bound < 0
value.WORSE: both seeds > 0 and pooled 95% lower bound > 0
value.endpoint: ResNet minus CNN raw exact-value MSE on solved300 at generation 6 (supporting only)

note: Disposable tiny-budget pipeline test in a separate directory. Its networks, games and numbers are not results and are not used for any design choice other than confirming that the pipeline runs.
